Planning is complete. Final report:

## Spec fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer — planned, 7 tasks, validated

**What was produced**: a new Flow-Next spec for the native PDF.js renderer (no iframe/object/embed, no framing relaxation), written to full template convention (Goal/Design direction, Architecture, API Contracts, Edge Cases, R1–R19 acceptance criteria, Boundaries, Decision Context, Quick commands, Early proof point, Requirement coverage), plus an implementable 7-task breakdown sized for one work-iteration each, with file lists, line-referenced investigation targets, design context, and per-task verification commands. `flowctl validate --spec fn-112… → valid, 0 errors`.

**Task IDs and waves** (parallel candidates in the same wave):
- Wave 1: **.1** doc-asset Range + realpath hardening, `/vendor/pdfjs/` asset routes, CSP `worker-src 'self'` (+ records the clean-upstream test baseline first) · **.2** pin `pdfjs-dist@5.7.284`, `lib/pdf.ts` bootstrap (zoom/fit math, link sanitizer), pdf-lib fixtures
- Wave 2: **.3** rendering core — hooks, PdfPageView, aligned TextLayer, IntersectionObserver virtualization (the early proof point)
- Wave 3: **.4** PdfViewer shell + Scholarly Dusk instrument-rail toolbar, designed states, keyboard a11y
- Wave 4: **.5** DocView integration (isPdf branch, Pages/Text toggle reusing `showRawView`, fallback)
- Wave 5: **.6** Playwright smoke + P-1…P-6 performance evidence + npm package smoke
- Wave 6: **.7** docs (API.md/WEB-UI.md/serve CLAUDE.md/features.yml/CHANGELOG) + final gates vs baseline

**Process followed**: read all mandated instructions (root/`.claude` CLAUDE.md+AGENTS.md, serve/test CLAUDE.md, ADR-001, `.flow/usage.md`); inspected DocView.tsx, `handleDocAsset`, CSP/server.ts, security.ts, tests, packaging, fixtures, and the prior spike's diff (evidence only). Used the **frontend-design plugin** for the design direction (signature "instrument rail" + examination-stand page treatment, grounded in ADR-001) and the **Flow-Next plan skill** end-to-end: 6 scouts in parallel (repo, practice, docs, memory, spec, docs-gap; github-scout disabled in config) + flow-gap-analyst, then Route-A spec set-plan and task creation via flowctl.

**Research materially changed the spec**: (1) pdfjs needs **cMaps + standard fonts** served same-origin too, or CJK/non-embedded-font PDFs silently break the offline guarantee — added two routes and R3 coverage; (2) `isEvalSupported` was **removed in pdfjs v5** — R13 rewritten around `enableScripting`-never-set + CSP-without-unsafe-eval + a JS-action fixture; (3) npm `latest` is pdfjs 6.x — spec pins the last v5 (`5.7.284`) with the v6 bump recorded as future update surface; (4) THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES is vendored-code-only by repo convention, so no entry is added (decision recorded in spec); (5) TextLayer alignment requires the `--total-scale-factor` CSS contract; (6) React 19 StrictMode double-effect guards for `loadingTask`.

**Exact key commands run**: `.flow/bin/flowctl spec create --title "Native PDF.js Document Renderer" --json` → `fn-112-native-pdfjs-document-renderer`; `spec set-plan … --file …` (twice: initial spec, then research-amended spec+plan layer); 7× `task create --spec … --deps … --description-file … --acceptance-file … --satisfies …`; `validate --spec … --json`.

**Files changed** (git status contains only intended Flow-Next artifacts): new `.flow/specs/fn-112….{md,json}`, new `.flow/tasks/fn-112….{1..7}.{md,json}`, `.flow/.gitignore` (one-line `.locks/` addition from `flowctl init`), `.flow/memory/` scaffold (init-created), plus the pre-existing `.flow/fable-spec-plan-receipt.json`. An EOL-only churn of `.flow/bin/flowctl.cmd` was reverted. No product code touched; nothing committed or pushed.

**Deliberate deviations / planning risks**:
- **Tracker projection skipped** — the Linear bridge is active with `perEvent.plan=reconcile`, but I did not project fn-112 to Linear: an outward write from this dedicated planning checkout risks a duplicate issue in the real GNO team and wasn't requested. Run `/flow-next:tracker-sync fn-112…` from the canonical repo if wanted.
- **Flow-Next copy drift**: local `.flow` copy is 3.5.0 vs plugin 3.5.1 (warned once, proceeded per autonomous rule; consider `/flow-next:setup` refresh).
- **Spec not marked ready** — readiness is adopted in this repo; mark with `flowctl spec ready fn-112…` after Sol's plan review approves.
- **Overlap, no dep edges**: fn-61 and fn-60 (both open) also touch `DocView.tsx`; fn-63 may later centralize keyboard shortcuts — merge-coordination noted in the spec's Execution notes.
- **Residual technical risk** is concentrated in task .3 (worker bootstrap + text-layer alignment under Bun's HTML-import pipeline — no prior worker/virtualization pattern in this codebase); the early-proof-point framing tells the implementer to stop and re-evaluate (explicit `workerPort` fallback) before building UX on top. Performance budgets are QA-evidence targets on named fixtures, deliberately not CI-gated.
- Per governance, I did not run plan review (`review.backend=none`; Sol reviews independently) and made no visual/performance success claims — R18 forbids deriving those from source.
